video_style: Realistic documentary footage of an indoor facility in one uninterrupted continuous shot.
lighting: Soft, cool early-morning daylight from the windows on the right; the ceiling lights are off at first, leaving the far side of the room dim.
perspective_view: Static wide view from a high corner of the room, looking diagonally across the desks toward the glass entrance door at the far end.

subjects_lifecycle.subject_attribute: An adult office worker seen from a distance, wearing a dark coat and carrying a shoulder bag.

init_frame_visual_description: A quiet modern open-plan office early in the morning, seen from one corner. Light oak floor, white ceiling with acoustic panels, and a row of large windows along the right wall. A glass entrance door stands closed at the far end of the room. Two rows of white desks with dark monitors and black task chairs fill the middle of the room, and a small lounge with a grey sofa sits near the windows. The ceiling lights are off and the room is empty. The space contains a glass entrance door about 1.0 m wide to the left in the background, a rows of desks about 6.0 m wide to the left in the foreground, a grey sofa about 2.2 m wide to the right in the foreground.

events.event_description: The glass entrance door at the far end opens and a person walks in; the ceiling lights switch on across the room as they enter.
